chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Abd Allah ibn Amir, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Abd Allah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about shortening the prayer. He said: When you are in the place where you do not hear the adhan, then shorten; and when you return from your journey, it is likewise.

key_terms.الْأَذَانَ: the call to prayer used here as a practical boundary-marker
key_terms.الْمَوْضِعِ: the place or location that determines the ruling

ai.seo_question: When is it permissible for a traveler to shorten salat according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding when a traveler may perform taqsir in salat. The criterion mentioned is reaching a place where the adhan is no longer heard, and the same standard applies when returning from travel.
